subject: Renewal: mid-cycle uplift, co-terming options and smoothing approach
messages:

Cc: procurement@calyxhealth.com
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-contract uplift — need options for co-term and smoothing

Hi Rachel,

Hope you had a good week. We hit a usage inflection this quarter: several of our pipelines (model inference for clinical triage) have grown ~45% month-over-month and the Q1 consumption is already above the current committed band. Our procurement team asked me to get options for how to add capacity mid-contract with minimal invoice shock and — if possible — co-term the uplift into our upcoming renewal (Dec 31).

High-level asks:
- Can Redwood propose a staged uplift plan that smooths billing over the remainder of the term (we're sensitive to capex in this quarter)?
- What discount/price protection can you offer for committing to an incremental amount now versus a one-off true‑up?
- We may need a slightly different invoice cadence for the uplift (monthly amortization vs single upfront) — is that supported?

I attached a stripped usage export (usage_report_Q1.csv) to give you visibility. We're targeting +60% committed capacity by start of Q3 if we proceed. Would the team be available for a short call next week to review commercial options? Procurement copied.

Thanks,
Emma Li
Head of Platform
Calyx Health

From: rachel_kim@redwood.com

Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mid-contract uplift — need options for co-term and smoothing

Hi Emma — thanks for the context and the upload. Really pleased to hear the product is scaling. We've reviewed the CSV and pulled a short set of commercial options that should match Calyx's priorities (smooth cashflow, price protection, and co-terming). High-level options attached (Calyx_SOW_draft_v1.pdf) — summary below.

Option A — Staged amortized uplift (recommended for cashflow):
- Incremental commit added in three equal monthly tranches over the next 90 days.
- Billing: monthly amortization applied to invoices (no single large upfront).
- Price: incremental volume priced at 8% discount off current committed rate; lock price for remainder of the year.
- Co-term: incremental commit auto-aligns to 12/31 renewal; no separate contract start/end.

Option B — Single true‑up with tiered credit (recommended for simpler accounting):
- One-time addition to commit now; invoice for the full uplift, with a one-off credit schedule if usage drops later.
- Price: 12% discount on the uplift if commit is annualized immediately.

Option C — Voucher/bridge (best if you expect further growth and want flexibility):
- Purchase voucher units at a deeper discount (15%) that can be consumed over 12 months.
- Voucher applies to compute-only tokens; no change to base SLA or data controls.

Next steps I suggest: 1) internal alignment on preferred option; 2) 30‑min pricing review with Priyom to nail final discount and amendment language; 3) procurement-friendly SOW and DocuSign amendment.

Call windows: Mon 3/22 10–11am PT or Tue 3/23 2–3pm PT — let me know what works.

—Rachel
